    public class DataQuery
extends FieldRelatedEDPQueryDescriptor

        public DataQuery setOffset(int offset)
        Sets the offset for the data query. The offset is the number of records to be skipped by the server within the query result.
        Parameters:

      • getTimeout

        the query timeout

      • setTimeout

        public DataQuery setTimeout(int timeout)
        Sets the timeout for this data query in milli seconds. If this value is different to 0, the server will abort query execution after the timeout has elapsed, regardless how many records there have been found. If timeout has elapsed, a status message will be received to indicate the timeout event.
        Parameters:
        timeout - timeout for query execution in milli seconds. 0 means no timeout.
        Returns:
        this object
